stories.headline: Stocks have their worst day since July; BTC bends but holds ~$81.6k
stories.blurb: The S&P 500 fell about 1.1% and the Nasdaq about 1.9% on the CPI print, while bitcoin slipped roughly 2% on the day and is flat on the week, still up about 8% on the month. — Crypto holding its range while equities sold off is a sign of resilience; a daily close under ~$80k would break the range and flip the 7D view to Bear.

stories.headline: BTC ETFs: Tuesday inflow breaks the run, Wednesday tracking red
stories.blurb: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $176M on Oct 13, led by Fidelity and BlackRock; Oct 14 was tracking an outflow but was not complete at this rebuild. The last five complete sessions are still net negative (about −$598M). — One green day isn't a trend — demand needs a run of inflows to support a push back toward $86k.

stories.headline: Futures deleveraging is slowing, not reversing
stories.blurb: CheckOnChain still shows a Deleveraging Sell-Off as of Oct 14, but the seven-day drop in futures OI eased to about 1% against a ~2% price slip; funding stays mildly positive. — Most forced-selling fuel has been burned off, which helps a floor hold — but nobody is adding leverage yet to drive a rally.
